## What this does

Runs **after** the operator signed the Round-10 acceptance readout
(`docs/build/readouts/ACCEPT-R10.md`, SIGNED 2026-09-28 — accepts the
`CAPSTONE_CLOSURE.md` §(f) packet **as presented**; every register row stays
owed). P33.4 reconciles the backlog record and publishes the operational
readiness state of the signed-off round — it normalizes/verifies, it does not
re-home, close, or sign anything.

- **`docs/build/OPERATIONAL_READINESS.md` §(f)** (appended; sections (a)–(e)
  keep their Round-3/4 snapshot untouched): the Round-10 readiness state.
  (f1) readiness by domain — **implemented** (the landed spine: typed
  assertions, role/count semantics, bitemporal contract, publication
  eligibility, audit/recovery machinery, shadow-only obligation events +
  closeout protocol, blinded-eval tooling `awaiting_humans`, reviewed
  acquisition queue, immutable releases + FTS5 search + workspace, intake +
  correction application, dossiers + funnel, candidate identity + publish
  verification + journey portfolio, `sig.composed-verification/1` pass 20/20,
  the capstone packet + register guard) vs **fixture** (composed verification
  on a scratch PG18 spine, 25/25 staging publish verification, 38-check
  journey portfolio, `prepared_not_executed` return-pass packets — a fixture
  or staging pass is never a live or public pass) vs **hosted** (no
  production Round-10 leg executed; `D-R10-LIVE-1`/`D-P32.23a-1`/
  `D-R10-PUBLISH-1` OPEN; `D-FEDERAL.1-1` + `D-P31.4-1` scheduled) vs
  **public** (no new exposure — the candidate is staged not served; the
  intake receiver answers `503 receiver_not_operating`) vs **human**
  (GATE-G3 + GATE-ACCEPT signed; the deferred S3 spine, reviewer sessions,
  rights lanes, participants, operating packet, credentials and maintainer
  repair-shape decisions all still owed).
  (f2) the backlog-home sweep — verified, nothing re-homed.
  (f3) **a concrete RETURN PASS for every owed row** — all 18
  Round-10-scoped obligations + all 18 carried-forward rows get the exact
  re-dispatch command (`implement-spec … live_verification=true`, the
  committed `LIVE_RETURN_PASS.json` sequence, or the recorded human action)
  plus the gate it waits on; `SIG-MEM-004` stays scheduled chain work owned
  by P33.8 (row 200).
- **`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — P33.4 sweep record** (appended; a sweep
  record, **not** a status change — no row closed, opened, re-homed or
  re-worded): `check_backlog.py` exits 0 — `risk deferred rows: 102/102`,
